notes.title: Chinese localization update - 游戏中文文本重置更新
notes.content:
Hi players,


This update is a minor one, focusing on improvements to the existing Chinese language : )
Updated and fixed various Chinese language issues with a new Chinese translator.
Improved Chinese grammar and item descriptions for better readability.
Filled in missing translations and corrected errors in the original translations.


各位玩家们大家好，
我是该游戏最新的汉化者升雾代课老湿，在此次汉化的更新中，我完全重做了该游戏的中文文本并作出了很多改进：
重写了所有UI、剧情与对话的文本，让它们更顺溜，也做出了一些有趣的本地化改动。
补齐了所有先前版本中遗漏的翻译，翻译错误的地方也被修正。
你是否因为寻找或制作武器配件整个人都闹麻了？我已经为每个武器配件添加了正确的文字形式的分类，这样你就不会因为看到6个“握把”或者“弹匣”而不知道该装给那把枪了！同时我也修正了所有物品的正确名称，一些武器的专属配件我也作出了备注。
未来作者的新游戏我也会负责汉化，感兴趣的各位也请稍安勿躁，希望现在最新的汉化更新能各位更好的游玩游戏了解剧情！（不过原作者的文本是真的松弛别告诉他们哈


This update credit goes to: MILK.FOR.FREE 升雾代课老湿


Regards,
Cristi P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.title: BIG UPDATE & BIG NEWS
notes.content:
Hi Players,




We are pleased to present you a major update! Sadoff really worked hard on this update and we hope you will enjoy it. What's new?

-Equipment and weapons can be transferred directly from any character, and with all improvements. This greatly simplifies the replacement of fighters when injured or tired.
- The queue for the repair or improvement of cars allows you to use them before the start of maintance.
- The queue for Training and Healing also does not distract people from work while they are waiting.
[b]- Added a time acceleration feature during the mission.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/bb4cee92c7fa4008155af5559de2cfcd3a2ae82e.png[/img]

[b]- Added sandbox mode if you just want to ride around the map and see the research and equipment.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/8639f784e552f914959c7e04cffd6de9ef97cc43.png[/img]




Also as an extra news, the prequel of our Chromosome Evil Franchise will have a demo debut during Steam Next Fest starting this Monday.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/503c828b18f23b4fa272a8a5243d020177ef4b30.png[/img]

Smash that wishlist button Commander

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3015620/Welcome_Back_Commander/



Regards,
Cristi P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.title: BIG Update, BIG News, BIG Giveaway
notes.content:
[h1][b]BIG UPDATE[/b][/h1]

Hey Players,

Chromosome Evil 2 had a multitude of small patches and updates lately and also some major improvements and additions so here is the new stuff:

- Sadness and depression can be cured in the hospital / based on player suggestion
- When the fuel runs out, events now occur on the global map, rather than instant game over.
- full support for manual saves
- Soldiers can now return to battle if they accidentally leave the location
- some minor polish
- some balance adjustments
- simplified Chinese translation added
- bug fixes


[h1][b]BIG NEWS[/b][/h1]

We recently joined forces with TogeProductions and TouchDImensions to create a unique bundle for all fans of tactical squad-based games.

This bundle contains our original [i]"Chromosome Evil"[/i] alongside the awesome [i]"Strain Tactics"[/i] and the famous [i]"Infectonator Survivors"[/i]

You can check it out here: 

 https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/33948/Tactical_Squad_Creations/

Also ...
 
Our old title TAURONOS joined forces with Equinox Hunt to create "The Thrill of Escape" bundle for the ones of you who enjoy top-down thriller games

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43174/The_Thrill_of_Escape/


[h1][b]BIG GIVEAWAY[/b][/h1]

To celebrate all these events & milestones we are doing one BIG giveaway.

We have 2 main goals during this campaign:
1. to reward our audience and engage them in a fun challenge
2. to receive some help with the game exposure - we are indie devs so our marketing funds are basically 0 and we rely on the community for that exposure boost.

[h2][u]PRIZES[/u][/h2]

1st place: 1 Steam key for Chromosome Evil 2
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2529770/Chromosome_Evil_2/

2nd place: 2 Steam keys for Chromosome Evil so that you may gift your friends
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1035660/Chromosome_Evil/

3rd place: 3 Steam Keys for Strain Tactics
https://store.steampowered.com/app/621810/Strain_Tactics/

4th place: 3 Steam Keys for Infectonator Survivors

7th place: 3 Steam keys for TAURONOS
https://store.steampowered.com/app/676240/TAURONOS/

[h2][u]How to enter the giveaway[/u][/h2]

STEP 1
Go to Twitter(X) and re-tweet this tweet with the quote: "I want this game"
https://x.com/16bitnights/status/1812836313306919270

STEP 2
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/yGWETWznm5 And post the link to your quoted re-tweet

STEP 3
Winners will receive the prizes this Saturday, 20th of July,
We are going to send the prizes via Discord private message so make sure you have private messages enabled on Discord.
Winners will pe picked randomly.


Good luck!

We would also like to thank [b]TogeProductions[/b], [b]TouchDImensions[/b], and [b]EvilStar studio[/b] for their donations!

As some of you know we also work on a new game "Welcome Back, Commander" which is the last installment from the "Chromosome Evil" franchise and will mark the end of our trilogy.

Also, its a prequel.

How can you help ?

notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/473aba5f241ed14640bf547425e93e09e28c262f.gif[/img]

[b]
UPDATE TIME
Bow&arrows are back[/b]


Good news, we managed to push one more big update for you!

A major update. Version 1.5x
. For those who have played recently:
1 Added a new bow weapon. At first, it is not strong, but it does not waste bullets, but consumes materials.
2 Improved ammo has been added:
-Enhanced. It just increases the hit damage.
Incendiary. If hit, there will be a chance to set fire to the target. Arrows are set on fire immediately. The target is constantly taking damage and will not live long.
Poisoned. If hit, there will be a chance to poison the target. Arrows infect immediately. The target slows down, weakens, and takes damage.
Explosive. Radically increase the damage. But we need to get to them...
-Weighted arrows throw off enemies.
3 Improved the burning and poisoning of enemies. Changed mechanics and damage. Also now they continue to burn and die even after losing their legs.
4 Everything except car repairs and mining can now be done on the go on the global map.


[b]New enhanced ammunition types[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/472632ef8ad21a0e6c61b2719f984b80dfeb0f8d.png[/img]

For those who played around the release:
1 At least 3 times there was a serious revision of the balance of the game. The complexity has increased, global effects have been added, and mechanics that did not work well at first have been debugged.
2 Added story missions during evolutionary jumps. The evolution system has also been revised. Enemies now have weapons after clear stages.
3 The cards for the grind have been replenished.
4 A lot of management changes. Fighters are now much more responsive, less sticky when managing allocation. The change of equipment in the inventory has been greatly reduced.
5 Heavy mode is now really heavy.
For those who haven't played yet:
If you were in doubt whether to take the game or not, now is the time to play a demo version and see that the game has become much more enjoyable to manage.lp of feedback from the players, we managed to improve the gameplay, bring the balance to a pleasant level, and introduce several mechanics that made the game even more interesting. Now you will be able to see not a raw game, but one that is quite worthy of your attention. Since the release, many bugs have been fixed and many edits have been made to make it better. The game is not dead, but continues to improve and I am always open to suggestions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/4c87fb64b241d81be4b4ac608fa8947de468a0da.png[/img]

Want to support us?
 Join our Discord:
https://discord.gg/USFbBSBeTZ



regards,
Cristi P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.title: BIG UPDATE + news of our current situation.
notes.content:
Hey Players,

It's been 2 weeks since we released the game so now it's time to share some of the data behind the curtain, a summary, and a big update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/838bcc36757727d83f1c905d6f0a0d85ac93cf13.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/51f9b3b1af5df4a20f434d2c55a920f321c1b90e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/061dc48d57415ea084e4acb1ec0f0a4a3a70329a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/a68c264b7a7e23c683ca50b9aa91f2daa972f1fa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/d662af5cee1dd56b35c600ef4eaaf06ea332aae1.png[/img]

First good news, Chromosome Evil 2 got approved for trading cards, we just uploaded the trading cards artwork and we are waiting for final confirmation, I estimate they should be dropping by the end of next week.



[b]Summary since the release:[/b]

- bug fixing, my partner had a marathon in fixing bugs, it's hard to track but overall he made fixes each day since the release, and we must add here an addition Thank you players for having patience with us
- minor balance adjustments
- minor quality of life features

[b]Today's BIG Update[/b]

- Re-balance, today a huge re-balance of the game took place, mele was to OP and the game lacked that dangerous element, we noticed in many videos that people would just grind everything, well no more, now you will need real survival skills
- New content, we added 5 evolution event scenarios(chapter 3) that will get triggered on certain evolution stages to spice up the survival experience.


WARNING: because we added a lot in this new update there might be some new bugs, if you encounter them please report them, and my partner will fix them.




[b]Our current situation[/b]

Well unfortunately here the situation is not very good for us.
We failed to reach any of our major milestones in matter of sales and Steam engagement.

This was due to a number of factors, fortunately, the game quality is not one of them.

Right now we are on the floating line and we must consider our next move very carefully.
We probably have funding left to keep making games until the coming winter, so if any Game of Thrones fans around here know that for us the"winter is coming" expression is BRUTAL.



[b]The future[/b]

We have read all the reviews and noticed that the people who played it liked our creation a lot, which brought joy to our hearts.
So, right now we are going to fix all bugs that get reported including balance adjustments.
And if the game will get serious attention from the player community in the future we will also consider adding more extra content to it.



Thank you, players!









Regards
Cristi P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.title: Map Editor Update
notes.content:
Hey Players,


We decided to release the map editor for free as part of the main game as a Holiday gift.

Also if by any chance you manage to make some interesting maps within the game theme, you can send them to our discord and we might add them to the main game map pools.

We wish you Merry Christmas and happy Holidays!






Best regards,
Cristian P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.title: News & Updates #2
notes.content:
Hey Players,

Lots of new things we did in the past 2 weeks.

The most critical was a serious bug that caused random crashes at the start of the game or on load of a game.
Well good news everyone, that critical bug was fixed, unfortunately, it caused a serious drawback with our deadlines but we believe we can still handle it.

We apologize for any problems caused by this critical bug and we want to thank you all for not losing faith in us, there was one guy who despite this critical bug still gave us positive feedback, this truly heartwarming for us and we will do our best not to let you down.

This being said here is what was updated in the 14 days since the last update announcement:

[b]1. BUG FIXES[/b]
-Global Map Pathfinding fix
-Double research
-wrong ammo icon
-pathfinding near cars
- 2 maps without top layer fix
-save train bug (makark0dy)
-shock hero effect bug (I'm S.W.A.T)
-scout missions fix (I'm S.W.A.T)
-usual prelude crash (makark0dy)
- high-level crawler crush
- part 1 base attack event
-Video settings changes in the core engine. Must fix crushes on first launch and options settings.
-lvl 4 armors fix
-skill requirement hint
-Exoskeleton lvl2
-finally, we handle loading crush

[b]2. POLISH[/b]
-Global map rollovers with location names (old saves with have temporary names)
-worm nerf
- overall balance difficulty was increased based on a lot of feedback from our discord regarding game being a bit too easy

[b]3. BALLANCE[/b]
-Sniper rifle mechanic tunes

[b]4. MAJOR UPDATE[/b]
- added City apartments map pool
- Dead corpses, yes many of you asked for them so we made the sprites based on enemy skins, adding an extra layer of satisfaction when you destroy those creatures
- Global map random encounters mechanics and encounters themselves

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/52924ee4e6a79f2a5e9330acd9555423fe910c0d.png[/img]



Now if any of you have any suggestions for scenarios within the current engine limits please don't hesitate to join our Discord ( [url=https://discord.gg/EANch3Uprr]https://discord.gg/EANch3Uprr[/url] ) and share them with us.






Regards,
Cristian P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.title: News & Updates
notes.content:
Hey Players,

It's been 10 days since the Early Access release and before I continue with the new updates I want to clarify one thing.

We released in Early access so that means the game is NOT finished and because we constantly push new content and fix bugs new bugs will occur, but rest assured we will fix them all as long as the bugs are reported on the bug report topic or on our discord.
I say this because I noticed some people expected finished clean games in Early access and if that is the case I strongly suggest you stay away from this game until the full release(somewhere in February we hope) and only try it out now if you want to get involved in its development and support the developers.



This being said here is what was updated in the 10 days since the release:

[b]1. BUG FIXES [/b]
-turrets fixed (many reports)
-secondary visit location 
-russian version pathfind crash (Атлас)
-z,x zooming centered (RAVEN3.8X)
-keyboard settings popUp fixed (RAVEN3.8X)
-rollovers on weapon statistic (makark0dy)
-shield mechanics fixed (MazzledMarrow0)
-car upgrade save bug (makark0dy)
-added spellings on empty build materials(Spearmann99)
-duplicate craft items (makark0dy)
-Enemy damage state crash on high levels (alwaysDrunk)
-Wrong fix car (dr. turtle)
-fix + upgrade crash (alwaysDrunk)
-Global map roads dissapear .
-traps ammo refill on MULE
-Ambulance crash
-Roof MULE walk crash
-part 2 arrival crash
-Ammo box crash (КИБЕРПСИХ)
-Pathfind freeze on global map (always drunk)
-Info screen in Load menu glitch (КИБЕРПСИХ)

[b]2. POLISH[/b]
- Game over screen based on game over trigger(scenario, fuel event and defense event)
- Load game screen with detailed preview information on slots

[b]3. BALLANCE[/b]
- some fine balance tunes

[b]4. MAJOR UPDATE[/b]
- Global map was added on Chapter 3 (fair warning: this is serious mechanic so you might encounter some bugs)
- Chapter 3 intro and splatscreen

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/c0900493d09f85c58f78d8e99c4cc1785f45c524.png[/img]

Now if any of you have any suggestions for scenarios within the current engine limits please don't hesitate to join our Discord ( [url=https://discord.gg/EANch3Uprr]https://discord.gg/EANch3Uprr[/url] ) and share them with us.




Also if it's not too much to ask, fill out this survey so that we may see if we are going in the right direction: 


[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSczXdgKD7JWSNHJVww59Hq309ON_uO0r04GIXfoFTrEj2B7IA/viewform?usp=sf_link]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSczXdgKD7JWSNHJVww59Hq309ON_uO0r04GIXfoFTrEj2B7IA/viewform?usp=sf_link[/url]





Regards,
